meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目配置语言服务器，让代码诊断和跳转生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会识别项目语言，读取对应语言服务器的说明，给出安装命令和配置片段，并用脚本检测服务器是否装好、验证诊断功能是否可用。
howto.when: 当用户要求配置 LSP、安装语言服务器，或报告“没有 LSP 服务器 / 服务器未安装”这类问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目配上 TypeScript 的 LSP。
say.note: 会识别语言并给出安装命令和配置片段。

say.text: LSP 服务器没安装，帮我看看怎么处理。
say.note: 会定位对应语言服务器并给出安装步骤。

say.text: Python 的服务器我想换成 basedpyright。
say.note: 会给出选择服务器的配置片段。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude detects the project language by file extension, reads the matching language-server reference, gives per-OS install commands and config snippets, and runs scripts to check server status and verify diagnostics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to configure LSP, install or set up a language server, or reports 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed' errors.

say_en.text: Configure TypeScript LSP for this project.
say_en.note: Claude detects the language and provides install/config steps.

say_en.text: LSP server isn't installed, help me fix it.
say_en.note: Identifies the right server and gives install commands.

say_en.text: I want to switch the Python server to basedpyright.
say_en.note: Provides the config snippet for choosing servers.
